responsibility: This file contains GCC selftests for the garbage collector and GTY/gengtype integration. It defines GTY-annotated test roots and object graphs and verifies marking of ordinary structures, variable-length arrays, tagged unions, inheritance hierarchies, chain_next/chain_prev traversal, user-supplied GTY hooks, deletable globals, destructor-based finalization, and tree objects; in unchecked builds it also supplies dummy generated root tables so references from generated gtype files still link.
